text_block_list.name: Refreshing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Mmmph, so refreshing!
Nothing beats melon soda at lunchtime!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Melon... soda...?

One early afternoon. In the cafeteria,
I spotted Satono Diamond taking an interest
in melon soda.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All right, I think I'll try drinking one too♪
Melon soda is... this one, maybe?

And with that, teacup in hand,
she cheerfully bounced over to the drink bar――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes? What can I do for you~?
choice_data_list: You drink it from a teacup?
You drink it from a teacup?
Is this your first time having melon soda?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes? What can I do for you~?
choice_data_list: You drink it from a teacup?
You drink it from a teacup?
Is this your first time having melon soda?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is correct, but...
Ah, was my etiquette improper?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then could you teach me the proper etiquette?
I just love trying new things!
I explained to Satono Diamond that melon soda is usually drunk from a glass. However――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood, right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall borrow my father's
crystal glasses next time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was purchased from overseas, and it's extraordinarily beautiful, so――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It looks like it would match the color of melon soda too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

...Somehow, this whole event made me realize
just what a completely different league Satono Diamond is in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hehe, just looking at it
makes me so excited.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
――By the way, I wonder how much real melon
is actually in melon soda?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? It is "Melon Soda," isn't it?
choice_data_list: No, it's kind of like melon pan, so……

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Melon bread...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that's another first for me!
Does this "melonpan"? also
come packed with tons of melons!?

Perhaps due to differences in how we grew up――
it took quite an effort to explain, as it didn't come across easily.
